"""Accepted action construction for Class A profile mirroring."""

from __future__ import annotations

from src.autopilot.contracts import PlannerAction, as_string_list
from src.autopilot.contracts.keys import PK_CONTROL_ID, PK_OPTION_TEXTS
from src.key_catalog import PK_REQUIRED, PK_SELECTOR_HINT, PK_WIDGET_FAMILY
from src.key_catalog.planning import PK_FIELD_INSTANCE_ID
from src.types.typed import JsonObject, JsonValue, as_str

from ..acceptance import PlannerAcceptanceContext, finalize_accepted_action
from ..constants import SOURCE_PROFILE_MIRRORED


def _class_a_action(
    field: JsonObject,
    intent_id: str,
    value: JsonValue,
    confidence: float,
    needs_confirmation: bool,
) -> PlannerAction | None:
    """Build a profile-mirrored action after shared acceptance."""
    control_id = as_str(field.get(PK_CONTROL_ID), "")
    action = PlannerAction(
        intent_id=intent_id,
        value=value,
        control_id=control_id,
        widget_family=as_str(field.get(PK_WIDGET_FAMILY), ""),
        runtime_selector_hint=as_str(field.get(PK_SELECTOR_HINT), ""),
        required=bool(field.get(PK_REQUIRED) or False),
        confidence=confidence,
        verify=False,
        source=SOURCE_PROFILE_MIRRORED,
        needs_confirmation=needs_confirmation,
    )
    return finalize_accepted_action(
        action,
        PlannerAcceptanceContext(
            value=value,
            widget_kind=as_str(field.get(PK_WIDGET_FAMILY), ""),
            option_texts=as_string_list(field.get(PK_OPTION_TEXTS, [])),
            control_id=control_id,
            field_instance_id=as_str(field.get(PK_FIELD_INSTANCE_ID), ""),
            source_kind="profile_fact",
            source_id=intent_id,
            evidence_verified=True,
            needs_confirmation=needs_confirmation,
        ),
    )
